name: Live splits
author: OpenRAC contributors
description: Splits a LiveSplit timer as the player goes from planet to planet: the mod talks to LiveSplit's own server and splits at every planet, so a speedrunner does not have to touch the timer.

settings.name: Split
settings.description: When the timer is split. Reached: the split is taken when the planet's level is loaded, so the flight and the loading are in the segment before. Left: the split is taken when the game goes back to the galaxy map, so they are in the segment after.

settings.name: Start

choices.name: At the first planet (the mod resets and starts the timer)

settings.description: Who starts the timer. At the first planet: the mod resets LiveSplit and starts it when the run's first planet is loaded. By hand: the mod never resets or starts the timer; start it yourself, before the first split.

settings.name: Game time
settings.description: Send the game's own time (its ticks) to LiveSplit, for the Game Time timing method. With the timer started by hand, the time is counted from the first planet, not from the moment you start the timer.

settings.name: Server port
settings.description: The port LiveSplit's server listens on (its Settings, the LiveSplit Server group).

settings.name: Protocol
settings.description: How the mod talks to LiveSplit's server. Ask the server: the mod tries the TCP server and, when that is not there, the WebSocket one.

settings.name: Trace
settings.description: For bug reports: a line in the game's log for every planet reached and left, and for the timer the mod starts.
